operatorProperties.code:
def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    df = pd.read_csv('data/environment/input/constitution_beach_datasheet.csv', skiprows=2, header=0)
    df.columns = ['Date', 'Rain_1Day', 'Rain_2Day', 'Rain_3Day',
                  'Tag_North', 'Entero_North', 'Tag_Middle', 'Entero_Middle', 'Tag_South', 'Entero_South']
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Date'])
    df = df[df['Date'].str.strip() != '']
    return df

operators.customDisplayName: Load constitution_beach_datasheet.csv, skip first 2 rows, assign column names for Date, Rain (1/2/3-day), and Tag+Enterococcus for North/Middle/South sampling points. Drop rows with no Date.

Filter to 2024 dates, check each of North/Middle/South sampling points against the 104 count threshold (meets standard if Enterococcus < 104). Flag days as 'mixed' where at least one non-null point meets the standard and at least one non-null point does not meet the standard.
Show all days flagged as 'mixed' (at least one sampling point meets standard, at least one does not) for manual verification of correctness.
